initial_prompt: List 10 specific, practical steps I can take this month to reduce my personal carbon footprint, in bullet points only.

messages.content: List 10 specific, practical steps I can take this month to reduce my personal carbon footprint, in bullet points only.

- Replace 3–5 car trips per week with walking, biking, or public transit (start with short, easy trips).  
- Do a “meat-light month”: make at least half your meals vegetarian and avoid beef/lamb entirely.  
- Turn your home heating/cooling thermostat 1–2°C (2–3°F) closer to outside temp and wear layers/use fans instead.  
- Wash clothes in cold water only, and line-dry at least one load per week instead of using the dryer.  
- Unplug or fully power down electronics at night; use a power strip you can switch off for TV, consoles, chargers.  
- Commit to a “no-fly month” (no air travel), or if flying is unavoidable, combine trips and choose non-stop flights.  
- Change the settings on your devices to reduce screen brightness and enable energy-saving/sleep modes everywhere.  
- Plan and batch errands so you do one multi-stop trip each week instead of several separate short car trips.  
- Cut food waste by planning meals, freezing leftovers, and doing one “eat the fridge” day weekly before shopping.  
- Switch one recurring purchase this month to a low-waste option (e.g., refillable cleaning products, bulk foods, or reusable coffee cup/bottle).
